q.en: I. Heavy rain. II. The match was cancelled. The relationship is:
q.as: I. প্ৰবল বৰষুণ। II. খেলখন বাতিল হ'ল। সম্পৰ্কটো:

options.en: I is the cause and II the effect
II is the cause and I the effect

explanation.en: Heavy rain caused the match to be cancelled.
explanation.as: প্ৰবল বৰষুণৰ বাবেই খেলখন বাতিল হৈছিল।
